routing.ru_direct.title: Russian sites directly

routing.app.v2rayng: Rules are built into every config of the subscription.

certs.name: Name in the certificate
certs.self_signed_note: Let's Encrypt has not issued a certificate for the IP yet, so the browser warns about this one. The connection is still encrypted, and Hysteria2 clients check this certificate by its fingerprint. Port 80 must be reachable from the internet; the panel retries every 6 hours.
certs.acme_note: The certificate renews itself 30 days before it expires.
certs.ip_note: A certificate for an IP address lives about six days and renews itself every few days. Port 80 must stay open.
certs.get_ip: Get a certificate for the IP
certs.ip_failed: Let's Encrypt did not issue a certificate for the IP, the own one stays: {detail}
certs.domain_hint: The domain's A record must point to the server IP. Port 80 is needed while issuing.
certs.switched_ip: Running on the IP with a Let's Encrypt certificate
certs.confirm_domain: The panel and subscriptions move to {domain}. Hysteria2 links change: everyone using Hysteria2 needs to refresh the subscription.
certs.confirm_ip: The panel and subscriptions move to the IP address with a Let's Encrypt certificate (an own one if it cannot be issued). Hysteria2 links change: everyone using Hysteria2 needs to refresh the subscription.
certs.errors.invalid: Enter a domain such as vpn.example.com.
certs.errors.dns_not_found: The domain is not in DNS. Check the A record.
certs.errors.dns_mismatch: The domain points to {ips}, the server is {server}. Fix the A record and wait for DNS to update.
certs.errors.acme_failed: Let's Encrypt did not issue the certificate: {detail}
dash.no_metrics: Metrics are collected on a Linux server only.
dash.cert_error: The certificate was not renewed: {error}. Swift tries again in a day.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Details are in the server log.
errors.network: The server does not respond. Check the connection and try again.
errors.xray_rejected: Xray did not accept the settings: {detail}. The previous settings keep working.

profiles.empty: A profile is a way to connect. Create the first one: Swift picks the port, keys and disguise itself.
profiles.choose_hint: Pick a type, Swift sets up the rest.
profiles.kind.vless_reality_vision.title: VLESS Reality
profiles.kind.vless_reality_vision.desc: The main option: fast and indistinguishable from plain HTTPS.
profiles.kind.vless_reality_xhttp.title: VLESS XHTTP
profiles.kind.vless_reality_xhttp.desc: A fallback for networks that cut long TCP connections.
profiles.kind.hysteria2.title: Hysteria2
profiles.kind.hysteria2.desc: For poor and mobile networks: runs over UDP.
profiles.fields.name.label: Name
profiles.fields.name.hint: How the profile is named in the user's app.
profiles.fields.port.label: Port
profiles.fields.port.hint: 443 looks like ordinary HTTPS. Change it if the port is taken.
profiles.fields.serverNames.label: Disguise domain
profiles.fields.serverNames.hint: The site the connection imitates. Separate several with commas.
profiles.fields.target.label: Target address
profiles.fields.target.hint: Where Xray forwards foreign requests. Usually the disguise domain and port 443.
profiles.fields.fingerprint.label: Browser fingerprint
profiles.fields.fingerprint.hint: Which browser the client's TLS handshake imitates.
profiles.fields.shortIds.label: Short ID
profiles.fields.shortIds.hint: Short hex labels, separated by commas. Rarely needs changing.
profiles.fields.privateKey.label: Reality private key
profiles.fields.privateKey.hint: After replacing the key everyone needs to refresh the subscription.
profiles.fields.path.label: Path
profiles.fields.path.hint: Server path that carries XHTTP traffic. Must start with /.
profiles.fields.mode.label: XHTTP mode
profiles.fields.mode.hint: auto picks the best transfer method for each client.
profiles.fields.obfs.label: Salamander obfuscation
profiles.fields.obfs.hint: Hides QUIC traffic. Without it Hysteria2 is easier to spot.
profiles.fields.obfsPassword.label: Obfuscation password
profiles.fields.obfsPassword.hint: Shared by all clients of the profile. Refresh subscriptions after changing it.
profiles.errors.invalid: This value does not fit. Check the format.
profiles.errors.port_conflict: The {network} port is taken by {by}. Choose another one.

settings.panel_path_hint: 8 to 32 lowercase Latin letters and digits. The panel does not open without it.
settings.panel_pinned: Port and path are set in /etc/swift/swift.toml. Change them there and restart Swift.
settings.panel_confirm: The old address will stop answering. Save the new one, then sign in again:
settings.panel_moved: Panel moved, opening the new address
settings.panel.errors.range: The port must be from 1024 to 65535.
settings.panel.errors.pinned: The port is set in swift.toml.
settings.panel.errors.invalid: 8 to 32 lowercase Latin letters and digits.
settings.password_hint: At least 12 characters. Other devices will be signed out.
settings.errors.wrong_password: The current password does not match.
settings.errors.password_too_short: The new password must be at least 12 characters.
settings.xray_never: Updates have not been checked yet
settings.xray_major: This is a new major version and the config schema may have changed. If Xray does not answer within 10 seconds, Swift brings {current} back by itself.

settings.xray_note: Before replacing the binary Swift verifies the archive SHA256 and checks the current config with the new version. The previous binary is kept until the next update.
settings.xray_errors.update_checksum: The archive SHA256 does not match the published one. Nothing was installed.
settings.xray_errors.update_rejected: The new version rejected the current config: {detail}. Xray was not touched.
settings.xray_errors.update_rolled_back: The new version did not answer within 10 seconds. Swift brought the previous one back, Xray is running.
settings.xray_errors.check_failed: GitHub did not answer. Try again later.
